# Deepgram

Deepgram provides AI-powered speech recognition and understanding services, offering APIs for real-time and pre-recorded audio transcription, text-to-speech, and audio intelligence.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/deepgram/.

## Actions

- **Get Project Usage Summary** (read-only): Retrieve a summary of usage data for a specified deepgram project.
- **Get Public Models** (read-only): Retrieve metadata on all the latest public deepgram speech-to-text models.
- **Get Public TTS Models** (read-only): Fetch metadata about all latest public tts voice models.
- **List Deepgram Projects** (read-only): List all deepgram projects.
- **List Project Scopes** (read-only): List all scopes for a specified deepgram project.
- **Summarize Audio**: Generate concise summaries from audio content.
- **Text-to-Speech (REST)**: Convert text into natural-sounding speech.
- **Topic Detection**: Transcribe audio and detect topics.
- **Transcribe Pre-recorded Audio**: Transcribe pre-recorded audio files into text.
